title: BET Announces New Chaka Khan Humanitarian Prize At Friday’s Soul Train Awards
summary: BET on Friday announced the creation of the Chaka Khan Humanitarian Award to recognize “musicians and cultural figures who have made outstanding contributions to humanitarianism, community service and social justice.” The award will be presented annually beginning in 2027 at the Soul Train Awards.
